steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Set your public hostname and certificate settings.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point at n8n's port 5678, keep the push WebSocket open; in n8n set N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_URL and N8N_PROXY_HOPS=1.

steps.title: Exposure - full app or webhooks only (optional)
steps.subtitle: Keep / for the editor and webhooks, or limit it to the webhook, form and waiting paths (see README).

steps.title: Methods, bodies and timeouts
steps.subtitle: The editor uses PATCH and DELETE; uploads are large and some workflows run long.

steps.title: HTTP - Webhooks, forms and chat
steps.subtitle: Callers and chat widgets burst past the default 2r/s per URL; keep unless callers are slower.

steps.title: HTTP - Public API and MCP clients
steps.subtitle: API loops and MCP client start-up burst past 2r/s per URL. If you expose neither, enter 2r/s, BunkerWeb's default rate.

steps.title: HTTP - Editor tabs behind one address
steps.subtitle: Each editor tab holds a push socket; keep unless one address never has 10 tabs.

steps.title: Security - Banned senders
steps.subtitle: A sender calling an unpublished webhook gets 404s; counting them would ban that address for a day.

steps.title: Security - Metrics endpoint
steps.subtitle: n8n serves /metrics without authentication when enabled; scrape it on the private network.

steps.title: Security - Embedding forms and chat (optional)
steps.subtitle: Keep to block framing; clear X_FRAME_OPTIONS and frame-ancestors only to embed forms or chat.

steps.title: CRS exclusions - editor save and run
steps.subtitle: Five editor requests skip the injection rules that workflow code would trip.

steps.title: CRS exclusions - webhook file bodies
steps.subtitle: Production webhooks accept raw file bodies; JSON and XML stay inspected.

steps.title: CRS exclusions - public API and MCP
steps.subtitle: Scripts and AI clients that create workflows from code skip the same injection rules as the editor.

steps.title: CRS exclusions - browser forms
steps.subtitle: Browser form posts carry empty-name parts, which ModSecurity cannot parse; the form body then goes uninspected.

steps.title: CRS exclusions - chat and MCP clients
steps.subtitle: Chat and MCP clients send a sessionId without a Referer; only that argument name skips CRS 943120.
